title: Renders read as 'late teens / early twenties' — persona age is undefined, and the reference workflow carried juvenile-adjacent tokens
evidence: Independent vision reads of three production renders all returned a youthful age: gen-1789832734 -> 'a young girl, likely a teenager'; gen-1789833673 -> 'late teens or early twenties'; gen-1789834527 -> 'late teens or early twenties'. The read is stable BEFORE and AFTER the checkpoint change (cyberrealisticpony -> Pornmaster), so it comes from the persona preset / identity LoRA, not the base model. Contributing inputs: the workflow preset carries 'petite face, small nose' (node 88), and the reference pipeline-20 preset additionally carried 'underbooba, underboobs' alongside the identity tokens (sarah1a3, s1_dram). The images themselves are fully dressed and pass the NSFW gate comfortably (0.0004-0.0722 against ~0.5), so this is NOT a gate failure -- it is an audience-fit and platform-risk question for a public Instagram account.

notes.note: Mechanism identified (2026-09-19 triage run). The live render path (pipeline 21 turbo-one-step-clean, step 40, node 79 = the NEGATIVE prompt) contains: adult, mature_face, sunken_eyes. The active workflow therefore POSITIVELY discourages adult/mature facial features, which is the mechanical cause of the youthful read; it is Pony-era negative boilerplate, not a creative choice about Sarah. Also confirmed live: node 88 no longer carries the sexualized tokens (underbooba/underboobs/submissive/obedient survive only in the deprecated pipeline-20 preset, kept under ops/backups/), and the age-adjacent tokens left are petit face tokens plus cute. Nothing in the repo states an age: personas has no age column, and SOUL.md/THESIS.md/FOUNDERS.md/packs are silent on it. Open question is one line from Tim - what age should Sarah read as. Pre-scoped fix once answered: drop adult, mature_face from node 79 negative (optionally also add an explicit adult descriptor to Growth::PillarPrompt::SAFE_BASE), then re-measure with a vision read. Re-measure needs a 4090 window and we hold no claim (prx-tg-latent-first-v34 holds it), so verification is blocked-on-slot. Left open, not guessed.
